::: {#rem-classification-binary-labels}
#### Labels in binary classification

In a [binary classification problem](#def-binary-classification),
the two [classes](#def-class) $k_1$ and $k_0$ are often labeled "[positive](#def-positive-classification)" and "[negative](#def-negative-classification)",
or, in medical diagnostic testing, "has the disease" and "does not have the disease".
:::
